exercises.prompt: Choose the sentence with a clear boundary between the two findings.
exercises.context: The survey included 120 students. Most used online resources twice a week.

options.text: The survey included 120 students most used online resources twice a week.
The survey included 120 students, most used online resources twice a week.
The survey included 120 students. Most used online resources twice a week.

exercises.explanationVi: Đáp án C dùng dấu chấm để tách hai mệnh đề độc lập hoàn chỉnh.
exercises.additionalExample: The response rate was high. The sample was still limited.
exercises.ieltsRelevance: Clear sentence boundaries reduce run-ons and comma splices in IELTS Writing.

authoring.construct: Recognise two independent clauses and choose a valid sentence boundary.
authoring.observableBehavior: Selects the only option that separates both complete findings correctly.
authoring.correctAnswerRationale: Both clauses have a subject and finite verb, so a full stop is valid.

distractorRationales.rationale: Two independent clauses are joined without punctuation or a conjunction.
A comma alone cannot join these two independent clauses.

authoring.detailedExplanationVi: Hai vế đều có chủ ngữ và động từ chính. Có thể tách bằng dấu chấm hoặc nối bằng liên từ phù hợp; dấu phẩy đơn không đủ.
authoring.sourceBasis: Original project-authored sentence applying standard English independent-clause rules.

exercises.prompt: Reorder the parts to make one complete sentence.

acceptedAnswers: Most students used online resources, but they also visited the library.

exercises.explanationVi: Liên từ “but” nối hai mệnh đề hoàn chỉnh và thể hiện sự tương phản.
exercises.additionalExample: The course was online, but students met weekly.
exercises.ieltsRelevance: Controlled coordination helps express contrast accurately in IELTS Writing.

authoring.construct: Build a coordinated sentence with a correct boundary and contrast marker.
authoring.observableBehavior: Places the conjunction between two complete clauses with correct punctuation.
authoring.correctAnswerRationale: The comma plus but correctly joins two independent clauses and preserves the intended contrast.

distractorRationales.response: but they also visited the library. Most students used online resources,
distractorRationales.rationale: The order breaks the intended report logic and leaves punctuation misplaced.

authoring.detailedExplanationVi: Khi hai mệnh đề độc lập tương phản, dùng dấu phẩy trước “but”. Trật tự này giữ thông tin chính trước rồi mới bổ sung điểm tương phản.
authoring.sourceBasis: Original project-authored sentence applying coordination rules.

exercises.prompt: Correct the sentence by adding a suitable boundary.
exercises.context: The survey covered first-year students, it did not include final-year students.

hint.copyVi: Hai vế đều là mệnh đề hoàn chỉnh; hãy thêm một liên từ chỉ tương phản.

acceptedAnswers: The survey covered first-year students, but it did not include final-year students.

exercises.explanationVi: Cần thêm “but” vì dấu phẩy đơn đang nối sai hai mệnh đề độc lập có ý tương phản.
exercises.additionalExample: The sample was small, but the response rate was high.
exercises.ieltsRelevance: This repairs a common comma splice in academic summaries.

authoring.construct: Repair a comma splice with an appropriate coordinating conjunction.
authoring.observableBehavior: Produces the declared corrected sentence after a targeted hint.
authoring.correctAnswerRationale: But marks the contrast and makes the comma-plus-conjunction boundary grammatical.

distractorRationales.response: The survey covered first-year students, it did not include final-year students.
distractorRationales.rationale: The original comma still joins two independent clauses by itself.

distractorRationales.response: The survey covered first-year students because it did not include final-year students.
distractorRationales.rationale: Because invents a causal relationship that the sentence does not mean.

authoring.detailedExplanationVi: Dấu phẩy đơn tạo comma splice. “But” vừa sửa ranh giới câu vừa giữ đúng ý đối lập giữa nhóm được khảo sát và nhóm không được khảo sát.
authoring.sourceBasis: Original project-authored sentence applying coordination rules.

exercises.prompt: Correct the fragment while keeping the meaning.
exercises.context: Although the response rate was high. The sample came from one faculty.

acceptedAnswers: Although the response rate was high, the sample came from one faculty.
The response rate was high although the sample came from one faculty.

exercises.explanationVi: Mệnh đề bắt đầu bằng “Although” không đứng một mình; nó phải nối với mệnh đề chính bằng dấu phẩy.
exercises.additionalExample: Although the course was flexible, some students preferred classes on campus.
exercises.ieltsRelevance: Accurate subordination supports clear concession in IELTS Writing.

authoring.construct: Repair a dependent-clause fragment in an academic limitation statement.
authoring.observableBehavior: Combines the dependent and main clauses without changing the claim.
authoring.correctAnswerRationale: Although introduces a dependent clause that must attach to the main clause.

distractorRationales.response: Although the response rate was high. The sample came from one faculty.
distractorRationales.rationale: The although-clause remains incomplete as a standalone sentence.

distractorRationales.response: The response rate was high because the sample came from one faculty.
distractorRationales.rationale: The correction invents causation and removes the concession.

authoring.detailedExplanationVi: “Although” tạo mệnh đề phụ chỉ sự nhượng bộ. Nối nó với mệnh đề chính bằng dấu phẩy để giữ cả giới hạn mẫu và ý tương phản.
authoring.sourceBasis: Original project-authored transfer sentence applying subordination rules.

exercises.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct survey summary.

options.text: The survey collected many useful information.
The survey collected a great deal of useful information.
The survey collected several useful informations.

exercises.explanationVi: “Information” là danh từ không đếm được; “a great deal of” phù hợp và không thêm -s.
exercises.additionalExample: The report provides useful information about study habits.
exercises.ieltsRelevance: Countability affects grammatical range and accuracy in IELTS Writing.

authoring.construct: Choose a quantifier compatible with an uncountable academic noun.
authoring.observableBehavior: Selects much information and rejects pluralised information.
authoring.correctAnswerRationale: Information is uncountable in standard English, and a great deal of can quantify it naturally in an affirmative sentence.

distractorRationales.rationale: Many requires a plural countable noun.
Information does not normally take a plural -s in this meaning.

authoring.detailedExplanationVi: Trong nghĩa dữ liệu/kiến thức, “information” không đếm được. Có thể dùng “a great deal of information” hoặc “a lot of information”, không dùng “informations”.
authoring.sourceBasis: Original project-authored sentence based on standard countability usage.

exercises.prompt: Seventy-two of 120 students used online resources weekly. Choose the accurate summary.

options.text: All students used online resources weekly.
Most students used online resources weekly.
No students used online resources weekly.

exercises.explanationVi: 72/120 lớn hơn một nửa nhưng không phải toàn bộ, nên “most” phù hợp còn “all” thì quá rộng.
exercises.additionalExample: Most participants completed the survey, but not all of them did.
exercises.ieltsRelevance: Accurate quantifiers prevent overgeneralisation in data descriptions.

authoring.construct: Map an explicit proportion to an accurate broad quantifier.
authoring.observableBehavior: Chooses most for a clear majority and rejects all/no.
authoring.correctAnswerRationale: Seventy-two is 60% of 120, a majority but not the whole sample.

distractorRationales.rationale: No contradicts the stated count of 72.

authoring.detailedExplanationVi: “Most” diễn tả đa số. Số liệu 60% hỗ trợ “most” nhưng không hỗ trợ “all”; việc chọn đúng lượng từ giữ phạm vi kết luận khớp dữ liệu.
authoring.sourceBasis: Original synthetic survey figures created for this project; no external dataset claim.

exercises.context: The report gives many advice about online study.

hint.copyVi: “Advice” là danh từ không đếm được; hãy đổi lượng từ và không thêm -s.

acceptedAnswers: The report gives much advice about online study.
The report gives a lot of advice about online study.

exercises.explanationVi: “Advice” không đếm được, nên dùng “much advice” hoặc “a lot of advice”.
exercises.additionalExample: The tutor gave two pieces of advice.
exercises.ieltsRelevance: Correct countability improves accuracy in academic recommendations.

authoring.construct: Repair quantifier agreement with the uncountable noun advice.
authoring.observableBehavior: Produces one of the two declared grammatical variants after a hint.
authoring.correctAnswerRationale: Advice is uncountable; much or a lot of is compatible with it.

distractorRationales.response: The report gives many advice about online study.
distractorRationales.rationale: Many requires a plural countable noun.

distractorRationales.response: The report gives many advices about online study.
distractorRationales.rationale: Advices is not standard for separate recommendations; use pieces of advice if counting.

authoring.detailedExplanationVi: “Advice” không có dạng số nhiều trong cách dùng này. Nếu cần đếm, dùng “a piece/two pieces of advice”.
authoring.sourceBasis: Original project-authored sentence based on standard countability usage.

exercises.prompt: Use all, most, or some: ___ students preferred fully online study (48 of 120).
exercises.explanationVi: 48/120 không phải toàn bộ và cũng không phải đa số, nên “some” là lựa chọn thận trọng trong ba từ đã cho.
exercises.additionalExample: Some respondents preferred a mixed schedule.
exercises.ieltsRelevance: Cautious quantification supports accurate Task 1 and Task 2 claims.

authoring.construct: Produce a bounded quantifier that does not overstate a minority proportion.
authoring.observableBehavior: Types some when constrained to all, most, or some.
authoring.correctAnswerRationale: Forty-eight of 120 is 40%; some is the only accurate option among the three supplied choices.

distractorRationales.rationale: All would require every one of the 120 students.
Forty-eight is less than half of 120.

authoring.detailedExplanationVi: Bài giới hạn ba lựa chọn để đáp án xác định. 40% là một phần của mẫu nhưng không phải đa số, vì vậy “some” giữ kết luận đúng phạm vi.
authoring.sourceBasis: Original synthetic survey figures created for this project; no external dataset claim.
